Volume read whole, January 5 to December 22, 1976: 36 regular meetings and 9 special meetings (site inspections on January 6, January 7, January 21, March 5, April 16, May 14, June 25, June 28, and November 9). The March 3, 1976 meeting is headed March 5 in the minutes but was held Wednesday, March 3 (March 5 was a Friday), and is recorded as March 3. The December 8, 1976 meeting page footer prints December 8, 1975. The March 10, 1976 stipulation list breaks off after the third stipulation in the scanned text. Appeal numbers are four-digit (7400s-7690s), variance appeals prefixed V-. Conflicts recorded as printed: appeal numbers 7426, 7461, 7462, 7573, 7665 and 7668 each used for two different appeals; the 7455 demolition address printed 539-599 Jackson Street on March 10 and 593-599 Jackson Street on March 17; the 7521/7522 Greenwich addresses printed 621/615-617 Greenwich on June 23 and 821/815-817 Greenwich on June 28 and June 30; the 7462 address printed 2253 Mission Street on September 8 against 2255 Mission Street elsewhere; the September 29 continuance list prints 7606 twice; the October 27 minutes state Appeal 7654 had been withdrawn, yet it was heard and decided November 10; the October 27 minutes state Appeal 7545 was off calendar by court order, yet it was on calendar and decided December 22; the December 15 minutes print a 5 to 1 vote with only four commissioners present, read as 3 to 1 to concur; Appeal 7696 is printed as such with a denial dated June 29, 1976, outside the surrounding 759x-762x numbering, and is recorded as printed. Skipped per the task rules: peddler, pushcart, taxicab, street-artist, mobile-caterer, jitney, driver-vehicle and loudspeaker-vehicle appeals; appeals with no building address; appeals about permits revoked or denied because of alleged criminal conduct; and decisions whose subject and address are never stated in the volume, including Appeals 7407, 7325, 7094, 7406, 7429, 7285, 7451, 7545, 7647 and V-7671.
